armSize.title: Arm Size Test
armSize.subtitle: Enter arm size and body fat. Upload to the arm ladder.

referenceInfo.title: Scoring Guide
referenceInfo.p1: Accepted: arm 1–70 cm, body fat 3–50%. Out-of-range blocked.
referenceInfo.p2: Dual normalization against sex-specific benchmark upper-arm circumference and baseline body-fat rate: leaner than baseline earns a definition bonus; higher body fat scales the score down to exclude soft-size inflation. Missing sex defaults to male norms.
referenceInfo.p3: Arm-size ladder only — excluded from six-axis radar and Home overall.

armSize.capNoticeBody: Raw score above axis ceiling (200) stores as 200 for ladder submission.
